DeployBot: deploy started for model-routing-v3 canary -> 10% cohort. change-window 2026-03-22T13:00Z-15:00Z. feature-flag scheduled: model-routing-v3 = enable at 10%.

Alice: seeing p95/p99 spike in canary dashboards at 13:08. p99 +30% vs baseline. :eyes: Should we hold and pin to v2?

Ben: Agree hold. Pause ramp, disable FF, and pin route to v2 while we investigate. Also create a brief release-note/incident. I'll take action unless someone objects.

Carla: Running quick eval on a 50-sample prompt set. Early evidence of rerank score drift — higher entropy and more hallucination-like tokens. Posting diff snippet:
```
{"id":"s01","v2_rerank_score":0.83,"v3_rerank_score":0.52}
{"id":"s02","v2_rerank_score":0.90,"v3_rerank_score":0.60}
```

DeployBot: canary paused at 10% by autoscaler. fallback policy engaged -> route fallback to v2 for affected nodes. Spike: 503 errors rose to 0.7% for ~3m, token latency p99 increased by 280ms.

Dan: +1 to pin. Command to pin (will run):
`redwood routes pin --route=model-routing --version=v2 --until=2026-03-22T18:00Z`

Alice: If we pin, do we need downstream cache invalidation? @eng-infra please advise. Also want to confirm whether it's a model kernel regression or config mismatch.

Eva: I'll draft the release note blurb and announce once the pin is confirmed. Also opening incident and scheduling postmortem if we rollback.

Ben: Executing pin command now... `OK` -> routing pinned to v2. Disabling feature-flag model-routing-v3 (cohort=0%). Confirming live routing tables show v2 serving 100%.

Carla: After pin, sampled responses realigned with v2 baseline. Saving eval results to S3 at s3://redwood-deploys/3312345678/eval.json

DeployBot: routing pinned to v2 at 2026-03-22T13:15:42Z. Feature-flag model-routing-v3 disabled. Canary drained. Autobalancer: normal.

Dan: Closing change window early. Filing ticket DEPL-1234 to investigate latency regression (assign infra + ml-runtime). Recommend a controlled rollback test in staging and kernel-level profiling next.

Alice: I'll run the diagnostic harness and share logs. ping me for any extra traces.

Eva: Release note (short): "Model-routing-v3 rollout paused due to increased inference tail latency. Routing pinned to v2 while we investigate. Impact: brief canary pause; no customer-facing change." Will post to #announcements in 10m.

Ben: Thanks everyone. Stand down for now; please keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
